entry.title: Retired general who led troops in Iraq warns U.S. exit may give Iran, ISIS an opening
entry.summary: Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, who commanded U.S. troops in Iraq, says the withdrawal could strengthen Iran and leave Iraq more vulnerable to ISIS.

entry.summary: The latest in the case of a former Cornell University student accusing seven fraternity members of sexual assault in 2024.

entry.title: Trump says top tech firms have signed accord to 'self-police' AI development
entry.summary: President Trump on Tuesday said that he and a large group of leaders of artificial intelligence companies had signed a voluntary accord that will include internal and external reviews.

entry.title: Hurricane Polo's remnants bringing more rain to flood-struck U.S. Southwest
entry.summary: The storm's remnants battered the U.S. Southwest, flooding roadways and forcing residents in small New Mexico towns to evacuate over concerns about a dam failing.
